summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted with fever, abdominal pain, and diarrhea. Initially concerning for C. difficile given recent antibiotic use, stool studies were negative. Urine culture grew E. coli, confirming a complicated urinary tract infection. She was treated with IV ceftriaxone, then transitioned to oral cefpodoxime. Renal transplant ultrasound was normal, and creatinine remained at baseline. She improved clinically, with resolution of fever and abdominal symptoms. She was discharged home on a full course of antibiotics with instructions to follow up with her primary and nephrology teams.
